tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: All top-level ADITUS API modules with direction (inbound = your systems call ADITUS, outbound = ADITUS data into your systems), endpoint counts and documentation URLs. Also lists the integration guides.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Every endpoint of one module (id, method, path, sub-group, one-line summary). Use the module id from list_modules.
